title: FlowFit
tagline: FlowFit , A Healthy Habit Builder App on the Flow Blockchain
description: We all know how hard it is to maintain good habits, and healthy ones often feel even tougher. This app changes that by letting you put a small, refundable stake on your workouts—even a simple walk. Successfully complete your activity, and you get your money back. Skip it, and you lose it. With data directly from Apple Health ensuring accuracy, you're free to focus entirely on establishing your new, healthy routine.
how_its_made:
Project relies on the React Native framework. Getting the development environment up and running, especially integrating with Xcode, proved quite complex, involving many steps and the constant need to clean up build files. I have also spent time configuring the necessary permissions to access both the Apple Health API and the Notifications API. To simplify Web3 account creation, I incorporated WalletConnect, and we chose the Flow blockchain for its ability to handle transactions quickly.

On blockchain side, I have used hardhat with ignition for solidity contract deployments on flow evm blockchain.
